business_problem: Action's pricing team could not scale spreadsheet-based pricing across ten European markets while coping with constantly changing products, competitor promotions, currency fluctuations, taxes, and the need to keep price parity across countries without compromising its low-price brand promise.
solution_summary: TCS rebuilt Action's pricing process around TCS Optumera, an AI-powered retail strategic intelligence platform used to move the retailer away from manual spreadsheet calculations. The platform takes in store price-check information, third-party competitor data, cost-price changes, currency movement, and promotion timing, then evaluates those signals against Action's pricing policies. It links new products to similar items, generates recommended prices, triggers automatic price changes when defined scenarios occur, raises alerts when thresholds are breached, and offers what-if simulations before rollout. Optumera also exposes the reason behind each recommendation so the team can keep transparency while scaling decisions. The result is a centralized pricing engine that helps Action maintain parity across countries, launch sharper initial prices, and expand quickly without losing control of local pricing strategy.
